title: journey-qa findings of one persona session
description: personas/<persona-id>/findings.json: the defects one independent persona session met. runners/explore/merge_findings.py removes duplicates across personas by the key class | detail | journey | locus, so those four fields must come from material every session shares: the detail codes of templates/issue-draft.md, the journey id, and the public docs location or product route.

persona.description: Roster people[].id; equals the session directory name.

class.description: docs, product and ux are defects; infra is an infrastructure quirk; procedure is a procedure violation (templates/issue-draft.md).

detail.description: Detail code from templates/issue-draft.md, or the adapter's own.

locus.description: Where the defect is, in terms every session can name: a docs location as file#anchor (not a line number, which differs between versions), or a product route path. Query strings and a trailing slash are ignored.

title.description: One line. The first persona's title heads the merged entry; the others are kept per persona.

step.description: Scenario step id or a short label, for the reader. Not part of the key: personas reach the same defect by different routes.

evidence.description: Paths relative to the persona directory (evidence/..., shots/...). Each must exist and stay inside it.

perspective.description: The persona fields that exposed it, for example device:mobile or assistive_tech:keyboard-only.
